issues.description: Off-topic frame: the final 'Grid Visual' frame (SVM/ML classification text + A1–F6 dot grid) is unrelated to mitosis and outside scope; it is a leaked/placeholder asset that breaks the scientific narrative and must be removed.

At t=0.0s only the left pole→kinetochore microtubule is drawn while the caption already asserts 'Opposite-pole attachment'; the right microtubule appears only at t=1.2s. Transient inconsistency between caption and visible attachment.

Cohesin is never rendered as a visible molecular complex; the sister connection is only implied by the chromatids staying joined at the centromere until ~6s plus the caption 'Sister cohesion is released'. Acceptable for grades 10-12 but the persistent cohesin relation is inferred, not shown.

The metaphase plate is not depicted as a plane/structure; alignment is only implied by the chromatids sitting midway between the two poles. No misleading physical membrane is shown, so ambiguity is low but the plane itself is absent.

checks.observation: Two sister chromatids (Sister A green, Sister B orange) are joined at the centromere as one duplicated chromosome at center, t=0.0–5.2s.

Sisters remain physically joined at the centromere through t=5.2s and the caption 'Sister cohesion is released' appears at t=6.2s; cohesin itself is not directly visible, so the connected-by-cohesin relation is inferred.
Left pole→kinetochore_A microtubule line visible from t=1.2s onward (absent at t=0.0s).
Right pole→kinetochore_B microtubule line visible from t=1.2s onward, giving bipolar attachment.
After release, Daughter A (green) moves toward the left pole and Daughter B (orange) toward the right pole at t=9.2–11.2s, matching kinetochore_A→pole_left / kinetochore_B→pole_right.
Cohesion-release caption at t=6.2s precedes visible sister separation at t=9.2–10.2s, satisfying cohesin_degradation → sister_separation ordering.
Chromatids are aligned midway between the two poles (equatorial position) during t=0.0–5.2s.
The two centromeric kinetochore beads face the opposite poles (left bead toward left pole, right bead toward right pole) at t=1.2–5.2s.

new_evidence: A non-mitosis 'Grid Visual' SVM/ML frame appears at the end of the video, with no counterpart in any retrieved reference; this is new, out-of-scope visual content.
limitations: No reference video exists; comparison uses static OpenStax illustrations (REF_5c388a09b4, REF_4ab08ec831) whose captions are not independent pixel verification.
References are simplified high-school schematics and may not match the generated video's exact geometry.
Cohesin and the metaphase plate are molecular/planar concepts not directly resolvable in the generated frames, so those relations rely on captions + spatial inference.
